title: Zoom Integration
description: Connect one or more Zoom accounts so admins can create Zoom meetings directly from the live-class wizard, with learners joining seamlessly via the embedded Meeting SDK.

retentionNotice.text: Zoom cloud recordings expire by default after 30 days (then 30 days in trash before permanent deletion). To preserve recordings beyond that window, use "Sync to Vacademy S3" on each recording from the session view — coming in a future release. For now, the default Zoom retention applies; you can extend it from your Zoom account settings.
